notes: SHIP v1.14.448 - R6 VERIFIED, AND A CDU IS COOLING NOT POWER. R6 VERIFICATION, ITEMS 1 AND 2. R6 changed NO application code - git proves it - so canonical inventory, RU placement, rack identity and renderer ownership are unchanged by construction rather than by inspection. MEASURED FIRST, then pinned: the LOD ladder the directive asks for is already built. Selected rack targetBright 1.0 with a moving spot, hero glow and focused plate; the other four foreground slots 0.55; empty pads 0.32; two rear rows of background dummies at 0.30 and 0.22. That is section 21 emphasis, section 22 tiers and section 33 quiet background, already shipped. New spec 32 pins those tier VALUES so a future ship cannot flatten neighbours into the selected rack, and adds the stress nobody had: 02-build-forge already cycles Build to aisle ten times and pins canvases at 5 and live contexts at 1, but nothing exercised the THREE-WAY cycle Build to rack detail to aisle - which is exactly where v1.14.441 found two surfaces fighting over the single context with the detail losing every exchange. Four cycles: live contexts stay exactly 1, canvas count does not grow, no page errors, and Build still holds a live context at the end. No component duplication, no mesh or material growth, no stale contents, no renderer growth. THE CDU, ITEM 3. _TMAP bridged raw cdu onto the pdu DISPLAY key, so every CDU in every Master rendered gold, labelled itself PDU and drew the power family six-PSU face. S4:099 RU02 is the live example. NO NEW COLOUR WAS INVENTED, and that is the point: the flat elevation has carried a ruled cooling channel all along - cooling/fan/crah/crac keep GREEN, a different channel and never in dispute - and the same ruling is what pulled pdu OUT of that group and gave it gold. _TMAP was the one place that never got the memo. The fix aligns the bridge with the ruling: cdu becomes its own display key, painted the cooling --green #30d158 lifted not re-picked, labelled CDU. Vocabulary.typeOf stays idempotent by construction and isDisplayKey is DERIVED from _TMAP, so the key registers itself with no second edit. Power is untouched - still gold, still PDU - and that is asserted, not assumed. A SECOND, OLDER MISCOUNT FIXED IN PASSING. The component tally keys on RAW slot types and had no cdu branch at all, so a CDU fell through to OTHER long before it was ever mis-coloured. Giving CDU a display key without fixing that would have left the bug in place looking deliberate. cdu now tallies as cooling alongside pdu. THE FAMILY. Section 15 asks for a heavier front housing, a distinct grille and a small neutral display. The CDU gets all three, built from SHARED materials so section 17 reuse is not undone. Grille slats are ONE InstancedMesh whose count scales with unit height, so a 4U CDU reads denser than a 1U one without per-slat geometry. THE SCREEN IS DARK AND STAYS DARK - section 15 says do not add fake values to a CDU display, and PHANTOM receives no coolant temperature, no flow rate and no pump state, so this family carries NO LED at all. Its identity is form, never a light pretending to be a reading. Asserted by test. NOTHING WAS FAKED IN THE DATA. No Master field, no normalized inventory value and no parser output changed - only the display key a raw code maps to. Pinned by a test that reads the stored slot back and asserts type, model, RU and component count are exactly what the Master said. LEGACY UNTOUCHED. The flat accent rule is body.rd-scoped only; the unscoped legacy background rule is not widened, so ?legacy=1 stays byte-identical. A CDU still reads grey under legacy - the pre-existing flat colours-2-of-11 bug that is owed its own ship. A TEST THAT FAILED FOR THE RIGHT REASON. 20-vocabulary went red on two tests: its CODES table hardcoded cdu maps to pdu, the SUPERSEDED ruling. The table was updated deliberately with the ruling recorded in it, not green-washed. Coverage is still 8 of 11 codes and the bay values confirm cdu #30d158 alongside pwr #ffcb45. RUNS (phone-webkit, each spec ALONE): 33 = 4, 32 = 3, 31 = 4, 30 = 4, 22 = 8, 20 = 6, 15-dual-source-master = 7, 16-normalization-migration = 7, 26 = 4, 02-build-forge = 14 including the x10 aisle round trip. GATES: 3 inline blocks compile, node --check sw.js, valid JSON, 12 style blocks brace-balanced, 0 bare LF, three-stamp lockstep at .448. DEVICE-VERIFY: open the s4:099 rack. PASS is RU02 reading as a CDU - green accent, labelled CDU, a solid grilled housing with a DARK screen - and the power shelves still gold and labelled PDU. FAIL is a CDU that is gold, says PDU, shows any lit readout, or a power shelf that turned green.
